title: Connect your mailbox
boundary: Select the region of your email service, independently of your Cindy region. Other providers and on-premises Exchange are not supported.
setupHelp: Change this only if your organization needs a custom application. Changing or clearing the application may require reconnecting existing mailboxes.
permissions: Permissions: account identity, mail read/write and sending, and offline access. Enterprise policies may require administrator approval.
builtInReady: Sign in with Microsoft. No application setup needed.
appMissing: Set up a connection application for this service first.
loadFailed: Unable to load account settings. Reopen this plugin page to retry.
connecting: Complete Microsoft sign-in in the browser. Select the same account when reconnecting.
requestFailed: Request failed. Reopen the plugin settings and retry.
connectFailed: Sign-in failed. Check the application registration and retry.
invalidClient: Enter the Application (client) ID in UUID format.
clientSaved: Application saved. Existing accounts must reconnect when the application changes.
clientCleared: Custom application cleared. Reconnect if the application identity changed.
NO_CLIENT_CONFIG: The application for this service is not ready. Contact the plugin maintainer or enterprise IT.
INVALID_CONFIG: Check the application Client ID and registered desktop redirect URI.
CALLBACK_INVALID: The authorization callback could not be verified. Retry sign-in.
EXCHANGE_FAILED: Microsoft rejected the authorization exchange. Check the cloud, public desktop app configuration, Client ID and exact redirect URI.
NETWORK: Unable to reach Microsoft. Check your network and retry.
TIMEOUT: Sign-in timed out. Try connecting again.
ACCOUNT_LIMIT: Account limit reached. Disconnect an unused account first.
VAULT_WRITE_FAILED: Unable to save authorization. Check local storage and try again.
LISTEN_FAILED: The local sign-in callback port is occupied. Close the other sign-in window and retry.
SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The authorization service is unavailable. Try again later.
multiAccountHelp: Mailboxes in both services stay connected. Switching services only changes setup for the next sign-in. Each service has its own default account.
defaultHelp: Used when no mailbox or service is specified.
requiredHelp: This service needs your organization’s own application. Ask your administrator for its Client ID.
copyManually: Redirect URI selected. Copy it manually.
